title: Next up on phones (Advanced)
caption: At Lv 27 on a phone, the first Next up card has a full-width button and the others are short rows, with "1 of 9" arrows to step through them.

title: Next up on phones (Basic)
caption: In Basic on a phone, the first card's button spans the card and the later cards are listed below it instead of in a small scrolling box.

title: Stepping to the story card
caption: The arrows bring the Lv 27 story quest Preparations for Restoration forward, with Turned in and its objectives, while the other cards stay short.
